item.title: Trump: "South Korea Not Interested in Helping on Hormuz... I Wasn't Happy" (트럼프 “한국, 호르무즈 문제 돕는데 관심 없어… 기분 별로였다”)
item.description:
Trump: "South Korea Not Interested in Helping on Hormuz... I Wasn't Happy" (트럼프 “한국, 호르무즈 문제 돕는데 관심 없어… 기분 별로였다”)

President Donald Trump said on the 19th that he "was not happy" when South Korea said it was not interested in helping the United States in the Strait of Hormuz, revealing that President Lee Jae-myung declined his request for assistance. Just two days after expressing his displeasure by even disclosing his phone call with President Lee on the 17th, Trump again brought it up, saying "he said 'no, thank you.'" Trump also addressed his directive to drastically reduce South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises, saying, "I have a friendship with Kim Jong-un, and he's been behaving well at least during my term, so I thought (conducting exercises) would be extremely insulting." (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 19일 “한국이 호르무즈 해협에서 우리를 돕는 데 관심이 없다고 말했을 때 기분이 별로였다(not happy)”며 이재명 대통령이 자신의 도움 요청을 사양했다고 밝혔다. 지난 17일 이 대통령과의 전화 통화 사실까지 공개해 가며 불만을 표출한 지 이틀 만에 “그가 ‘노 땡큐(no, thank you)’라고 말했다”며 이를 재차 거론한 것이다. 트럼프는 한미 연합 훈련 대폭 축소 지시 관련 “김정은과 친분이 있고 적어도 내 임기 동안 잘 행동하고 있는데 (훈련을 하는 것이) 굉장히 모욕적(insulting)일 것으로 생각했다”고도 했다.)

Trump made these remarks while meeting with reporters at the White House that afternoon, claiming that "South Korea imports 60% of its crude oil from the Strait of Hormuz." On his relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong-un, he said, "He didn't like Biden or Obama, but I maintain a good relationship" and added, "Even though I have a friendly relationship with him, I didn't like that we were conducting large-scale military exercises against North Korea, because I thought nothing would have happened." Earlier that morning, Trump claimed that North Korea possesses 57 powerful nuclear weapons and said he would meet with Kim Jong-un within the year. <<> When asked whether his goal in resuming relations with Kim Jong-un remains denuclearization and whether he expects to succeed this time, Trump avoided a specific answer, saying, "I don't want to talk about that." During his first term, Trump met with Kim Jong-un three times—in Singapore, Hanoi, Vietnam, and at Panmunjom—but achieved little. Unlike his first term, North Korea's nuclear and missile capabilities have advanced, and its strategic cooperation with Russia has deepened, so it remains uncertain whether Kim Jong-un will readily accept an offer for dialogue. North Korea maintains that it can only respond to talks if the United States recognizes its status as a "nuclear-armed state," while the Trump administration has upheld its official position of "pursuing the complete denuclearization of North Korea," regardless of the president referring to Kim Jong-un as a "nuclear power." <<> Meanwhile, President Lee said on his X (formerly Twitter) account on the 19th, "The South Korean government has stated on multiple occasions that it will actively join international efforts to restore freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz," adding, "We will continue to communicate closely with the U.S. side, as we have done so far, on various concrete contribution measures within the scope that South Korea's laws and basic policies can accommodate." He continued, "I look forward to reuniting with the esteemed President Trump in the United States in the near future," referring to the G20 summit scheduled for December at Trump's Doral resort in Florida. (트럼프는 이날 오후 백악관에서 기자들과 만나 ‘한국이 원유 수입의 60%를 호르무즈 해협에서 들여오고 있다’고 주장하며 이같이 밝혔다. 그는 북한 김정은과의 관계에 대해 “그는 바이든도, 오바마도 좋아하지 않았지만 나는 좋은 관계를 유지하고 있다”며 “그와 우호적인 관계를 맺고 있는데도 우리가 북한을 상대로 한 대규모 군사 훈련을 벌이고 있다는 사실이 마음에 들지 않았다. 아무 일도 일어나지 않았을 것 같기 때문”이라고 했다. 트럼프는 이날 오전에는 북한이 강력한 핵무기 57개를 보유하고 있다며 연내에 김정은과 만날 것이라고 주장했다.)

item.title: 50 Days Since US Congress 'Coupang Report' Released... Meeting with Leading Lawmakers? "Still Being Coordinated" (美의회 ‘쿠팡 보고서’ 발간 50일째… 주도 의원 면담? “아직 조정 중”)
item.description:
50 Days Since US Congress 'Coupang Report' Released... Meeting with Leading Lawmakers? "Still Being Coordinated" (美의회 ‘쿠팡 보고서’ 발간 50일째… 주도 의원 면담? “아직 조정 중”)

Fifty days have passed since the US House Judiciary Committee's interim report claimed that our government is 'discriminating' against Coupang over the personal information leak issue, and it has emerged that meetings with Republican Chairman Jim Jordan of the Judiciary Committee and Chairman Scott Fitzgerald of the Regulatory Reform and Antitrust Subcommittee, who led the drafting of the report, have not yet taken place. Since the report was released on the 1st of last month, the White House has used it to claim that "the Korean government has targeted Coupang," posing an obstacle to bilateral relations, yet diplomatic resources are not being投入 to address the actual 'critical point.' Around the release of the Coupang report, voices condemning the Korean government emerged in the US Congress almost daily, and a bill was even proposed to ban the entry of foreign officials involved in 'discrimination.' <<> At a plenary session of the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee on the 19th, Second Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jin-ah responded to a question from Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Ki-heon (Goyang-si, Gyeonggi Province, District B) asking whether Chairman Jim Jordan had been fully briefed on our government's position, saying, "Regarding Chairman Jordan and Representative Fitzgerald, who led the (report), direct meetings with lawmakers are still being coordinated" and "Instead, we are contacting and briefing the working-level staff and aides underneath them." In response, the lawmaker criticized, "Why isn't the Foreign Ministry's human network capacity with the US Congress being accumulated?" "I can't understand why a 'human network' hasn't been built despite investing so much money and time," and "It's embarrassing that when a major incident breaks out, we're only meeting with aides." <<> Vice Minister Kim said, "The embassy in the US is working to make as many contacts as possible" and "Additionally, we have hired an advisory firm to actively respond to Coupang's lobbying. Regarding the Judiciary Committee report, we are fully explaining our position on expressing regret, correcting errors, and the fact that only Coupang's claims were reflected." According to data the Foreign Ministry submitted to People Power Party lawmaker Kim Gun's office last year, the South Korean Embassy in Washington DC allocated a budget of 1.893 billion won for hiring advisory firms related to Congress and public relations. Japan is known to have as many as 20 advisory firms and law firms at its disposal. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon said, "It's questionable whether it's appropriate to hire advisory firms with taxpayers' money because we can't even meet with lawmakers, let alone the president." <<> Vice Minister Kim said, "I mentioned that contact with those two lawmakers (Jordan and Fitzgerald) is restricted and being coordinated" and "As for the rest, we are sending joint letters or directly contacting some lawmakers." Ambassador Kang Kyung-wha has met with members of both the House and Senate since the House's Coupang report was released on the 1st of last month, and some photos and details have been posted on the embassy's social media. Coupang, for its part, is waging an extensive public opinion campaign targeting not only the White House and Congress but also various figures in US political circles related to Korea. In particular, regarding the largest-ever fine of around 600 billion won imposed by the Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC), Coupang is known to be distributing even a 'table' comparing it to SK Telecom and Chinese company Ali, among others, to argue that our government is 'discriminating.' (우리 정부가 개인 정보 유출 문제가 불거진 쿠팡에 대해 ‘차별’을 하고 있다는 미 하원 법사위 중간 보고서가 발표된 지 50일이 흐른 가운데, 보고서 작성을 주도한 공화당 소속 짐 조던 법사위원장과 스콧 피츠제럴드 규제개혁·반독점 소위원장에 대한 면담이 아직까지 이뤄지지 않은 것으로 나타났다. 지난달 1일 이 보고서가 발표된 이후 백악관이 이를 근거로 “한국 정부가 쿠팡을 표적으로 삼았다”고 주장하며 양자(兩者) 관계에 장애물로 작용하고 있는데, 정작 문제의 ‘급소’를 다루는 데 외교 자원이 투입되지 않고 있는 것이다. 쿠팡 보고서 발간을 전후로 미 의회에선 하루가 머다하고 한국 정부를 규탄하는 목소리가 나왔고, ‘차별’에 연루된 외국 공무원의 입국을 금지하는 법안까지 발의됐다.)

item.title: Lee: "I Respect Trump's Will to Create Conditions for Dialogue by Reducing ROK-US Drills" (李 “한미훈련 축소해 대화여건 조성하려는 트럼프 의지에 경의”)
item.description:
Lee: "I Respect Trump's Will to Create Conditions for Dialogue by Reducing ROK-US Drills" (李 “한미훈련 축소해 대화여건 조성하려는 트럼프 의지에 경의”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 19th expressed his views on U.S. President Donald Trump's decision to reduce the South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises, stating, "I empathize with President Trump's will and efforts to create conditions for dialogue aimed at establishing a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula, and I pay respect to his decision." (이재명 대통령은 19일 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 한미연합훈련 축소 결정에 대해 “한반도에서 평화체제 구축을 위한 대화여건을 조성하려는 트럼프 대통령님의 의지와 노력에 공감하며 그 결단에 경의를 표한다”고 했다.)

President Lee made these remarks on X (formerly Twitter) that night, adding, "I hope that President Trump's decision will lead to the building of trust between North Korea and the United States, the resumption of dialogue, and ultimately the establishment of a stable peace regime on the Korean Peninsula." This came three days after U.S. President Trump abruptly ordered a significant reduction in the joint military exercises, which are the core of the ROK-U.S. combined defense. President Lee also said, "I look forward to reuniting with the esteemed President Trump in the United States in the near future." (이 대통령은 이날 밤 X(옛 트위터)에 이같이 밝히며 “트럼프 대통령님의 이 결단이 북미 간 신뢰 구축과 대화 재개를 거쳐 한반도의 안정적 평화 체제 구축으로 이어지기를 기대한다”고 했다. 트럼프 미국 대통령이 한미 연합방위의 핵심인 연합 군사훈련을 대폭 축소하라고 전격 지시한 지 3일 만이다. 이 대통령은 “머지않아 미국에서의 존경하는 트럼프 대통령님과의 재회를 기대한다”고 했다.)

President Lee noted, "I have carefully reviewed the SNS messages and photos President Trump has recently posted," and assessed, "President Trump's latest message feels like a major decision born of deep deliberation to move beyond hostility and confrontation toward peace on the Korean Peninsula." (이 대통령은 “트럼프 대통령께서 최근에 올리신 SNS 메시지와 사진들을 잘 보았다”며 “이번 트럼프 대통령님의 메시지는 한반도에서 적대와 대결을 넘어 평화를 만들기 위한 고심이 담긴 큰 결정으로 느껴진다”고 평가했다.)

He then mentioned that South Korea is evaluated as having the world's fifth-largest military power, saying, "In accordance with the agreement between the ROK and the U.S., we are rapidly increasing defense spending to achieve 3.5% of GDP for defense, and we are building sufficient capabilities to bear the defense of the Korean Peninsula ourselves. I fully agree with President Trump's will that the Republic of Korea must take responsibility for its own security." (이어 대한민국이 세계 군사력 5위로 평가받고 있다며 “한미 양국 합의에 따라 GDP 대비 국방비 3.5% 달성을 위해 국방비 지출을 급격히 늘려가는 등 한반도 방위를 스스로 감당하기에 충분한 역량을 갖춰가면서, 한반도 안보는 대한민국 스스로 책임져야 한다는 트럼프 대통령님의 의지에 전적으로 공감한다”고 했다.)

President Lee said, "I hope that President Trump's decision will lead to the building of trust between North Korea and the United States, the resumption of dialogue, and ultimately the establishment of a stable peace regime on the Korean Peninsula," adding, "As I have stated on multiple occasions, I will do my utmost to play the role of a pacemaker that facilitates and contributes to President Trump's peacemaker activities." (이 대통령은 “트럼프 대통령님의 이 결단이 북미간 신뢰 구축과 대화 재개를 거쳐 한반도의 안정적 평화체제 구축으로 이어지기를 기대한다”며 “이미 수차 밝힌 것처럼 저는 트럼프 대통령님의 이러한 피스메이커 활동을 촉진하고 기여하는 페이스메이커 역할에 최선을 다할 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz, President Lee said, "The South Korean government has stated on several occasions that it will actively participate in the international community's efforts, including the United States, to restore free navigation in the Strait of Hormuz," and "To that end, our government will continue to communicate closely with the U.S. side, as we have done so far, on various practical contributions within the scope that our laws and basic policies can bear." This appears to be aimed at Trump's public complaint that President Lee had not joined the U.S. efforts to denuclearize Iran. (이 대통령은 또 호르무즈 해협의 자유 통항과 관련해 “대한민국 정부는 여러 계기에 호르무즈 해협에서의 자유로운 통항 회복을 위한 미국을 포함한 국제사회의 노력에 적극 동참할 것을 밝힌 바 있다”며 “우리 정부는 이를 위해 대한민국 법령과 기본정책상 감내할 수 있는 범위내에서 여러 실질적 기여 방안에 대해 지금까지 해왔던 것처럼 미측과 계속 긴밀하게 소통해 나갈 것”이라고 했다. 트럼프가 ‘이 대통령이 미국의 이란 비핵화 노력에 동참하지 않았다’며 공개적으로 불만을 터뜨린 점을 겨냥한 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Democratic Party News Must Start with Democratic Party TV" – Targeting Kim Eo-jun? (김민석 “민주당 뉴스, 민주당TV로 시작해야” 김어준 겨냥?)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "Democratic Party News Must Start with Democratic Party TV" – Targeting Kim Eo-jun? (김민석 “민주당 뉴스, 민주당TV로 시작해야” 김어준 겨냥? )

Kim Min-seok, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said in a post on X on the 20th, "Now all of the party's news should start with dawn broadcasts through Democratic Party TV," adding, "We must begin a full-scale innovation, from the party's big brand concept to the look of meetings and even the attire of members." Within the party, this is being interpreted as a move to put the brakes on the practice of Democratic Party lawmakers relying on YouTube channels like those of Kim Eo-jun, a pro-opposition figure, and to bring the initiative in messaging back to the party. <<> On the same day, Leader Kim said, "I request this of Public Relations Committee Chairman Kim Nam-joon: please begin a full review of all aspects of the party's public relations or brand. We must start a full-scale overhaul, from the party's big brand concept to the look of meetings and the attire of members." He added, "Please also discuss, in cooperation with the Democratic Party TV task force, making Democratic Party TV the basic platform for all news produced by the party." <<> Leader Kim also said, "Please prepare consultations and discussions with party member groups and external experts regarding Democratic Party TV and related matters," and "Please arrange a public briefing session as soon as possible." <<> A Democratic Party official said, "We are pushing to create a party-level channel where Democratic Party lawmakers and members can voice their opinions," and "Leader Kim has a strong will to fundamentally overhaul the party's image and message dissemination system, going beyond simply launching a promotional channel." <<> Within the party, there are also interpretations that Leader Kim's remark about "should start with dawn broadcasts" is aimed at external spokespeople for the opposition camp, such as Kim Eo-jun. Major opposition messages or key issues tend to be produced and spread through Kim Eo-jun's YouTube broadcasts, which air every dawn. That same dawn, three supreme council members of the so-called pro-Chung (pro-Chung Chung-rae) faction—Choi Min-hee, Lee Sung-yoon, and Han Min-soo—appeared on Kim's YouTube show to state their positions on the written recommendation of Cho Hee-dae as Supreme Court Chief Justice. <<> An opposition camp official said, "There were frequent cases where Democratic Party lawmakers appeared in droves on external channels like Kim's, ahead of the party's official supreme council meetings or spokesperson briefings, to first state their positions on major issues," adding, "There have also been precedents where factional conflicts escalated on such YouTube channels, so I see this as a message to not ride on external spokespeople but to speak through the party's official platform." <<> The previous day, Leader Kim had also announced that supreme council meetings would be open in principle but warned that if any matter requiring confidentiality were disclosed, the person responsible would be expelled from the meeting regardless of rank—a move also interpreted within the party as an effort to tighten discipline. (김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 20일 엑스(X) 글에서 “이제 당의 모든 뉴스가 민주당TV를 통해 새벽 방송으로 시작돼야 한다”며 “당의 큰 브랜드 콘셉트부터 회의의 모습, 구성원의 복장에 이르기까지 전면 혁신을 시작해야 한다”고 했다. 이를 두고 당내에선 그간 민주당 의원들이 김어준씨 등 친여 유튜브 채널에 의존하는 관행에 제동을 걸고, 메시지 주도권을 당으로 가져오겠다고 선언한 것이란 해석이 나온다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: On PPP's Push to Impeach Cho Hee-dae, "Grounds for Impeaching President Lee" (장동혁, 與 조희대 탄핵 추진에 “李 대통령 탄핵 사유”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: On PPP's Push to Impeach Cho Hee-dae, "Grounds for Impeaching President Lee" (장동혁, 與 조희대 탄핵 추진에 “李 대통령 탄핵 사유”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on the 20th, "For the independence of the judiciary, the recommendation of Supreme Court justices should remain the exclusive authority of the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court." This came as the Democratic Party of Korea, targeting Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae, claimed that "breaking the convention of prior coordination with the presidential office and submitting the justice recommendation in writing is a declaration of war against the president," calling for his resignation and pushing for impeachment—prompting Jang to push back in criticism. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 20일 “사법부 독립을 위해 대법관 제청만큼은 대법원장의 고유 권한으로 남겨둬야 한다”고 했다. 더불어민주당이 조희대 대법원장을 향해 “청와대와 사전 조율하는 관례를 깨고 대법관을 서면 제청한 것은 대통령과 싸워 보겠다는 것”이라며 사퇴 요구와 탄핵 추진을 주장하자, 장 대표가 이를 비판하고 나선 것이다.)

At the party's supreme council meeting that day, Jang said, "The reason the Chief Justice was given the power to recommend Supreme Court justices was to ensure judicial independence. But if they say to coordinate in advance with the presidential office and recommend someone tailored to the president's tastes, is that even a recommendation?" Jang added, "Kim Min-seok's first words upon taking office as Democratic Party leader were about impeaching the Chief Justice. This vividly shows why President Lee Jae-myung poured everything into making Kim Min-seok the party leader. Was it all for this?" (장 대표는 이날 최고위원 회의에서 “대법원장에게 대법관 제청권을 준 이유는 사법권 독립을 위한 것인데 청와대와 미리 협의해 대통령 입맛에 맞는 사람으로 미리 조율하고 제청하라고 하면 그게 제청인가”라면서 이렇게 말했다. 장 대표는 “김민석 민주당 대표의 취임 일성이 대법원장 탄핵이다. 이재명 대통령이 김민석 당대표 만들기에 올인했던 이유를 극명하게 보여준다”며 “이러려고 김민석 당대표 만들기에 올인했던 것인가”라고 했다.)

Jang continued, "If the president expanded the number of Supreme Court justices in advance to appoint people to his liking, and if the final destination is a ruling of innocence for the president, then that is a unconstitutional yardstick. If it is the president who is orchestrating all of this, and if Representative Kim is making nonsensical remarks following the president's will, then the grounds for impeaching President Lee are clear." (장 대표는 이어 “대통령이 대법관을 자신의 입맛에 맞는 사람으로 임명하기 위해 미리 대법관 수를 늘린 것이라면, 그 종착역이 대통령 무죄 판결이라면 위헌적 잣대”라며 “이 모든 것을 벌이고 있는 것이 대통령이라면, 그리고 대통령의 뜻을 따라서 김 대표가 말도 안 되는 막말을 하는 것이라면 이 대통령의 탄핵 사유가 분명하다”고 했다.)

He went on, "If the Chief Justice did not coordinate in advance with the presidential office on the justice recommendation, that is precisely the proper way to uphold judicial independence. If Chief Justice Cho has resolved to protect judicial independence, he should start by resuming the president's trial proceedings." (그러면서 “대법원장이 대법관 제청에 있어서 청와대와 사전 조율을 하지 않았다면 그것이 바로 사법부의 독립을 지키는 제대로 된 모습”이라며 “조 대법원장은 사법부 독립을 지키기로 결심했다면 이 대통령 재판을 재개하는 일부터 다시 시작해야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also said, "The ruling party leader's first words upon taking office are not about people's livelihoods but 'step down, Cho Hee-dae'—I'm dumbfounded and deeply disappointed. Unlike former leader Jung Cheong-rae, he said he would avoid hostile politics and stably support state affairs, yet from day one he's issuing threats and intimidation against the Chief Justice. How is that different from former leader Jung?" (정점식 원내대표도 “집권 여당의 당 대표 취임 첫 일성이 민생 메시지가 아닌 ‘조희대씨 물러나라’라니, 기가 막히고 실망스러울 따름”이라며 “정청래 전 대표와 달리 적대적 정치를 지양하고 국정 운영을 안정적으로 뒷받침하겠다더니 첫날부터 대법원장에게 공갈 협박이나 늘어놓은 모습은 정 전 대표와 뭐가 다르냐”고 했다.)

Jeong added, "Yesterday at the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, the Democratic Party unilaterally passed a summons request for Chief Justice Cho without bipartisan agreement. They criticize the Chief Justice for breaking convention while destroying conventions themselves—a contradictory bunch of hypocrites. It was not Chief Justice Cho who staged a judicial coup but President Lee, and the worst ruling party since liberation is the Democratic Party." (정 원내대표는 “어제 법제사법위원회에서 민주당은 조 대법원장 출석 요구서를 여야 합의 없이 단독 의결했다. 대법원장이 관례를 어겼다고 비난하면서 스스로 관례를 무너뜨리는 모순된 내로남불 세력”이라며 “사법 쿠데타를 일으킨 것은 조 대법원장이 아닌 이 대통령이고, 해방 이후 최악의 집권 여당은 민주당”이라고 했다.)

Supreme council member Shin Dong-uk said, "They keep talking about conventions, but has the Democratic Party and the presidential office upheld even a single convention in the National Assembly or politics? And now they call it judicial abuse because the Chief Justice exercised the recommendation power without meeting in person? Even a passing dog would laugh at that." (신동욱 최고위원은 “관례, 관례 하는데 지금 민주당과 청와대가 그동안 국회나 정치권의 관례를 단 하나라도 지킨 것이 있느냐”며 “그런데 대법원장이 임명 제청권을 직접 만나지 않고 행사했다고 이것을 사법 농단이라고 얘기하느냐. 지나가던 개가 웃을 일”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Why Jung Cheong-rae Won't Stop Even After Losing the 'Myeong-Cheong Battle' (‘명청 대전’ 지고도 정청래가 멈추지 않는 이유)
item.description:
Why Jung Cheong-rae Won't Stop Even After Losing the 'Myeong-Cheong Battle' (‘명청 대전’ 지고도 정청래가 멈추지 않는 이유)

With Kim Min-seok elected as party leader at the Democratic Party's national convention, a new 'Myeong-Seok system' combining President Lee Jae-myung and Representative Kim has been launched. Jung Cheong-rae, the former leader who had competed against Representative Kim in the 'Myeong-Cheong battle,' is now out of power. The era of the 'Myeong-Cheong conflict' is over, and the 'Myeong-Seok solidarity' and 'Pro-Myung one-team' system is now in full operation. <<> In the past, candidates who lost a party convention typically kept quiet and entered a period of self-restraint. But former leader Jung Cheong-rae shows no sign of lowering his voice or bowing his head. Rather, he appears determined to say what he has to say and expand his political influence. <<> Immediately after the convention, Jung said, "Jung Cheong-rae lost, but his supporters won," and "Kim Min-seok won, but his arguments lost." He also said, "I lost in numbers, but I didn't lose my passion and values." He added, "Many people say I should leave the party because I didn't become party leader, but you absolutely must not do that. If you all leave the party, how can I survive all alone? Stay with me to the end and protect me." <<> To the pro-Jung supreme council members, he also said, "I trust you will play a 'major role' under Representative Kim Min-seok's system." Although he lost this primary, he remains politically viable, so he urged them to continue helping and supporting him. This reveals his intent to keep up the 'Jung Cheong-rae struggle' by playing the role of an opposition within the ruling party even under the Kim Min-seok system. <<> Why does Jung refuse to stop his fighting mode even after losing the 'Myeong-Cheong battle'? Does he believe there's a chance of winning an internal power struggle within the ruling party, given that the president's power is at its most formidable in the 'second year of his term' and the pro-Myung faction has regained control of the party? <<> The biggest reason Jung wants to raise the banner of independent factionalization after his convention defeat is reportedly 'resentment.' Jung has reportedly confided to those around him, "I couldn't speak out, and I've endured so much injustice." He claims he never intended to defy or disobey the president's wishes, yet the pro-Myung leadership treated him like a traitor or renegade. So now, he reportedly feels a strong urge to speak his mind freely—things he couldn't say as party leader. <<> The second reason is his confidence that while he lost the vote among paid party members in the Honam region, he won in the general public opinion poll. In the public opinion survey released on convention day, Jung edged out Representative Kim by 1.4 percentage points. However, that figure includes preference votes (second-choice votes for candidate Song Young-gil). In a simple head-to-head support race between just Jung Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok, Jung was reportedly ahead by about 4–5 percentage points. <<> Jung said, "Before adding the first-round second-choice votes from the public opinion poll, I think I was winning by about 5 percentage points." In other words, he lost among paid party members but won among the general public. This is interpreted as an emphasis on 'public sentiment is on my side.' Even in paid party member votes outside Honam—in the capital region and other areas—the vote gap between Kim and Jung was negligible. <<> He is actively touting that while Honam votes swung to Representative Kim because of the president's '80 trillion won Honam semiconductor mega-cluster investment plan,' he was never behind in party sentiment in the capital region, Yeongnam, or Chungcheong, nor in general public opinion. He appears to have concluded that he can survive as an independent force even under the Kim Min-seok system. <<> The third reason is the uncertain future of the 'Myeong-Seok system.' Although Representative Kim won the primary thanks to the president's full-throated support and Honam public backing, a rosy future is not guaranteed. Nearly half of the party members did not support Representative Kim. If he makes even a small mistake, the anti-Kim forces within the party could grow. <<> There are also many risk factors: real estate policy, the issue of dropping prosecutorial appeals, the constitutional amendment controversy, prosecutorial reform, and conflict with the judiciary. If any one of these goes wrong, the approval ratings of both the president and Representative Kim could fall together. For Representative Kim to resolve difficult issues and break through the political impasse, he will also need internal cooperation and support from the pro-Jung faction. <<> For Jung, there is room to grow his presence by speaking out on various issues. He could also elevate his position as an opposition within the ruling party. Although he lost to the 'Myeong-Seok alliance' in the primary, he believes the path to a comeback remains open if he maintains his political influence. Conversely, for the president and Representative Kim, winning the primary has left a bitter aftertaste. <<> On the first day of the Kim Min-seok system, the mood between the party and the presidential office was better than ever. The presidential office's political affairs team mobilized from early morning to deliver a congratulatory flower basket to Representative Kim. Usually, the senior presidential secretary for political affairs delivers such baskets, but on this day, Chief of Staff Kang Hun-sik, Senior Political Affairs Secretary Hong Ik-pyo, and Political Affairs Secretary Jung Eul-ho all came, and they even embraced Representative Kim. <<> The new leadership's first schedule is typically a visit to the National Cemetery. But on this day, the first item was a meeting between the party and the presidential office. This too is unusual. It's a scene that shows how much the presidential office welcomes Representative Kim's election. Both sides emphasized being 'one team without walls.' This speaks to how severe the conflict and breakdown in communication had been during Jung Cheong-rae's tenure. <<> Inside the presidential office, some reportedly said, "Representative Kim's election is President Lee's victory." This shows how much effort and anxiety the president invested in getting Kim elected. On the 19th, the president invited the three party leader candidates to the presidential office for dinner. He urged them to unite as one team centered on the new leadership. With a party-government meeting on real estate held that day, the first high-level party-government-presidential office meeting takes place on the 23rd. The 'Myeong-Seok one-team system' is now in full operation. <<> Some in the presidential office and the pro-Myung camp are also sensing a somewhat uneasy mood about the primary results. The presidential office and pro-Myung forces had expected a landslide victory. There was the announcement of the 800 trillion won Honam semiconductor investment and the president's order for a 'blitzkrieg.' Yet the capital region was a tight race, and they actually lost in the public opinion poll. They went all-in at the government level but failed to achieve a crushing victory. <<> There are three things the pro-Myung leadership finds particularly unsettling. First, excluding the preference votes in the poll, Representative Kim trailed Jung by about 4–5 percentage points. Jung also emphasized this—that he won among general public sentiment. <<> In the supreme council member race, pro-Jung candidates took first, second, and third place in the public opinion polls. Not only did all three who ran get elected, but they outnumbered the elected pro-Myung supreme council members (two). This gives them a numerical base in the supreme council to check Representative Kim. <<> Third, Kim Yong, the president's closest aide, lost despite other candidates withdrawing and publicly endorsing him. Although the pro-Myung camp supported him wholeheartedly, Kim's defeat came as a surprise. Kim finished last in the polls. This means that sentiment toward the president and his pro-Myung inner circle is worse than expected. <<> Although the Jung Cheong-rae system was toppled, the tasks facing the 'Myeong-Seok system' are piling up. The most urgent is real estate. There is strong criticism of the government's announced tax reform and supply measures for real estate. Representative Kim said he would 'fine-tune taxes' and 'devise supply measures,' but these are not easy tasks. <<> On the issues of constitutional amendment for presidential re-election or a two-term system, and dropping prosecutorial appeals, there is no disagreement between the party and the presidential office, but the opposition is pushing back and public opinion is not favorable. Party integration is even harder. In key party positions such as secretary-general and policy committee chair, most appointments have gone to pro-Myung figures. With three pro-Jung members on the supreme council, balanced appointments are difficult for now. <<> The biggest question is whether Jung and the pro-Jung camp will cooperate with the Kim Min-seok system. In this regard, pro-Jung figures are saying, "We will cooperate for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration, but we will say what needs to be said," and "We will play the role of an opposition within the ruling party." <<> Jung reportedly told those around him, "I held back and endured not being able to speak. There were many injustices." He claims that the merger with the Jo Kuk Innovation Party was promoted and announced according to the president's wishes, in coordination with the presidential office, yet the pro-Myung leadership blamed him for it and criticized him. He also argues that the abolition of prosecutorial investigation powers was a presidential campaign pledge, pursued with the consensus of the core leadership of the administration. But only the disagreement with the president was highlighted. <<> Jung said, "I lost, but our values won." To his supporters, he said, "Don't leave the party—stay to the end and protect me." Rather than accepting the election defeat gracefully and lying low, this is read as a determination to plan for the future. <<> Supreme Council member Choi Min-hee said, "I will stand with former leader Jung Cheong-rae to the end." She is vowing to remain loyal to Jung. She also said, "In a democratic party, dissenting views are natural," and "The concept of one team needs to be redefined." This means she will raise her own voice and pursue independent factionalization. <<> Representative Kim Min-seok now faces the task of coordinating between the party and the presidential office while also embracing the pro-Jung camp. If pro-Jung supreme council members like Rep. Choi Min-hee oppose Kim's line in leadership meetings, significant conflict could erupt. <<> However, it remains uncertain whether the pro-Jung camp will maintain a united front to the end. Pro-Jung lawmakers have their own nomination prospects at stake. Moreover, the pro-Myung camp's co-optation offensive will intensify. There are also predictions that some pro-Jung members could break away from Jung and cooperate with the Kim Min-seok system. <<> So, will the 'Myeong-Seok system' sail smoothly? For now, it will likely enjoy the convention bounce effect of its primary victory. The first hurdle is real estate. If they fail to present a tax revision and supply plan that the public finds convincing, the approval ratings of both the party and the presidential office could fall together. <<> The constitutional amendment and dropping prosecutorial appeals are also reefs. Pushing them too hard risks a public backlash. Whether the president's promised 2028 Honam semiconductor plant construction proceeds as planned is also critical. If the Honam semiconductor investment does not proceed as promised and hits snags, it could trigger an exodus of Honam sentiment and calls for holding the leadership accountable. <<> There is also considerable possibility that the pro-Jung camp will check Representative Kim in the supreme council. Former leader Jung Cheong-rae, author Yoo Si-min, and Kim Eo-jun could rock the Kim Min-seok system from outside. Bad news outweighs good, and risk factors are more visible than rosy forecasts. (민주당 전당대회에서 김민석 대표가 선출되면서 이재명 대통령과 김 대표가 결합한 ‘명석 체제’가 새롭게 출범했습니다. 그동안 김 대표와 경쟁하며 ‘명청 대전’을 치렀던 정청래 전 대표는 이제 야인(野人)이 됐습니다. ‘명청 갈등’의 시대는 가고 ‘명석 연대’ ‘친명 원팀’ 체제가 본격 가동된 것입니다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Kim Yong-gwan Featured in Aug. 15 Celebration Video… Why Are His Descendants Enraged? ([단독] 8·15 경축식 영상에 나온 김용관 선생… 후손들은 왜 분노했나)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Kim Yong-gwan Featured in Aug. 15 Celebration Video… Why Are His Descendants Enraged? ([단독] 8·15 경축식 영상에 나온 김용관 선생… 후손들은 왜 분노했나)

Of the six independence activists featured in the video shown at the Aug. 15 Liberation Day ceremony, Kim Yong-gwan (1897–1967) has been confirmed not to be a "person of merit for independence" because he never received a state decoration. President Lee Jae-myung and his wife also attended the event that day. Kim Yong-gwan's bereaved family told this newspaper on the 19th: "It infuriates us that the government, which says it will expand the discovery of unhonored independence activists, refuses to recognize him as a person of merit for independence, yet politically exploits him in the Liberation Day video." <<> The ceremony video shown on the 15th at Seoul Sejong Center for the Performing Arts featured six figures: Kim Gu, Ahn Chang-ho, Lee Hoe-young, Jeong Se-kwon, Jo So-ang, and Kim Yong-gwan. Kim Yong-gwan was introduced as an activist who led industrialization under the theme "Building National Strength Through Science." However, a government official said: "In the process of producing the theme video, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety did not consult with the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, and as a result, they were apparently unaware that Kim Yong-gwan had not been selected as a person of merit for independence." <<> According to this newspaper's comprehensive reporting, the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs had rejected Kim Yong-gwan's application for recognition as a person of merit for independence three times, citing "unclear independence movement activities." When President Moon Jae-in named five "independence activists" in his Aug. 15 Liberation Day address, Kim was the only one among them who was not a recognized person of merit. At the time, public opinion called for designating Kim as a person of merit, but he ultimately never received that recognition. <<> Choi Seong-hyeon (56), the grandson-in-law of Kim Yong-gwan, told this newspaper: "There are reports that he was arrested by the Japanese police in April 1938 after giving a lecture at the Jongno YMCA hall in Seoul on the 5th Science Day, but the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs says there is no specific detention record and refuses to recognize him as a person of merit." He added, "Presenting Kim as an independence activist at an official government event is insulting and mocking his descendants." The bereaved family reportedly gave up years ago on having him recognized as a "person of merit for independence" and destroyed all related supporting documents. <<> Kim Yong-gwan studied in Japan and was a leading figure in popularizing science and technology. Believing that a scientific revival was necessary to strengthen national power, he organized the "Invention Society" in 1924 and founded "Science Joseon," Korea's first popular science magazine, in 1933. In 1934, he established "Science Day" and devoted himself to enlightenment campaigns promoting the importance of science. The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs is known to view these activities as not being directly linked to the independence movement. The government designated Kim as a Korea Science and Technology Merit Honoree in 2020, but unlike national merit honorees, science and technology merit honorees reportedly receive no support or special treatment for their descendants. <<> Kim Geun-bae, a professor emeritus at Jeonbuk National University and current visiting professor at KAIST who specializes in modern Korean science history, said: "Even if it's hard to see a direct link to the independence movement, scientists who carried out scientific activities during the Japanese colonial period for the Korean people should be considered by the government as veterans deserving of honors equivalent to persons of merit for independence." He added, "The 'construction of a scientific Joseon' that Kim Yong-gwan and his colleagues championed at the time became linked to the 'nation-building through science' policy, which gave rise to today's Republic of Korea." (8·15 광복절 경축식 주제 영상에 등장했던 독립운동가 6명 중 김용관(1897~1967) 선생이 정부 서훈을 받지 못해 ‘독립유공자’가 아닌 것으로 확인됐다. 이날 행사엔 이재명 대통령 부부도 참석했다. 김용관 선생의 유가족은 19일 본지에 “미서훈 독립운동가 발굴을 확대하겠다는 정부가 독립유공자로 인정은 안 해주면서, 광복절 영상에서 정치적으로 이용하는 것에 분통이 터진다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling and Opposition Parties Hold Off on 'Yongsan Special Act Amendment'...To Be Processed After Discussions Between Ministry of Land and Seoul City (여야, ‘용산특별법 개정안’ 처리 유보…국토부·서울시 논의 후 처리키로)
item.description:
Ruling and Opposition Parties Hold Off on 'Yongsan Special Act Amendment'...To Be Processed After Discussions Between Ministry of Land and Seoul City (여야, ‘용산특별법 개정안’ 처리 유보…국토부·서울시 논의 후 처리키로)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party announced on the 20th that they would not process the amendment to the Yongsan Park Special Act at the plenary session. The bill is centered on allowing housing supply on parts of the site within Yongsan Park. (더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 20일 본회의에서 용산공원 특별법 개정안을 처리하지 않기로 했다고 이날 밝혔다. 해당 법안은 용산공원 내 일부 부지에 주택 공급을 가능하도록 하는 내용을 골자로 한다.)

Cheon Jun-ho, the Democratic Party's chief deputy floor leader, said, "We have agreed to observe the discussions between the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Seoul Mayor on the Yongsan Special Act, the Urban Maintenance Act, and the Urban Redevelopment Act, and to process them next week (on the 26th)." (천준호 민주당 원내수석은 “용산특별법, 도시정비법, 도시재정비법은 국토부장관과 서울시장이 논의하는 것을 지켜보고 다음주(26일)에 처리하는 것으로 의견 모았다”고 밝혔다.)

On this day, Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon were reported to have met at a location in Seoul to consult on Seoul's housing issues, including housing supply utilizing Yongsan Park. (이날 김윤덕 국토부장관과 오세훈 서울시장은 서울 모처에서 만나 용산공원을 활용한 주택 공급 등 서울 주택 문제를 협의하는 것으로 알려졌다.)

The government is reviewing a plan to utilize part of the site of Yongsan Park—a park and green area spanning 3 million square meters (approximately 907,000 pyeong)—as residential land to supply public rental housing targeting young people. Mayor Oh maintains the position that damaging the park is unacceptable, calling it "urban green space that must be passed down to future generations." (정부는 300만㎡(약 90만7000평) 규모의 공원녹지인 용산공원의 일부 부지를 주택용지로 활용해 청년층을 수요자로 하는 공공임대주택 등을 공급하는 방안을 검토 중이고, 오 시장은 “미래 세대에게 물려줘야 할 도심 녹지”라며 공원 훼손은 불가하다는 입장을 고수하고 있다.)

Meanwhile, on this day, the Democratic Party formed a 'Special Committee on Housing Supply Policy' at the Seoul city party level regarding youth housing measures, and decided to demand a youth housing supply package from the central party utilizing additional tax revenue. (한편, 이날 민주당은 서울시당 차원의 청년 주거 대책관련 ‘주택 공급 정책 특별위원회’를 구성하고, 추가 세수를 활용해 청년주택 공급 패키지를 중앙당에 요구하기로 했다.)

Kim Young-bae, chair of the Seoul city party, met with reporters after a youth housing crisis measures briefing hosted by the Seoul city party at the National Assembly Members' Hall that morning and said, "At the Seoul city party level, we will form a special committee on housing supply policy under the city party," adding, "We are planning site visits within next week." (김영배 서울시당위원장은 이날 오전 국회의원회관에서 열린 서울시당 청년 주거난 대책 간담회 후 기자들과 만나 “서울시당 차원에서 시당 산하에 주택공급 정책 특별위원회를 구성한다”며 “다음 주 중 현장 방문을 계획하고 있다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Oh Gi-hyung will serve as chair of the special committee, with lawmaker Kim Nam-geun as secretary. Seoul city council members, district council members, and youth and housing experts are also expected to participate. (특위는 오기형 의원이 위원장을, 김남근 의원이 간사를 맡는다. 서울시의원과 자치구의원, 청년·주거 전문가 등도 참여할 예정이다.)

Furthermore, Chair Kim said, "The issue of additional tax revenue is a matter to be discussed at the party level, as Secretary General Han Jeong-ae mentioned," but also stated, "We intend to formally and actively request that the central party review a plan to supply youth housing using additional tax revenue." (또 김 위원장은 “추가 세수 문제는 한정애 사무총장도 언급하신 바와 같이 당 차원에서 논의할 문제”라면서도 “적극적으로 중앙당에 추가 세수를 활용해 청년주택을 공급하는 방안을 검토해달라고 공식적으로 요구할 생각”이라고 말했다.)

Lawmaker Oh Gi-hyung proposed a specific financial input scale of approximately 20 trillion won. Oh said, "There is tax revenue referred to as additional tax revenue," and added, "I think we should boldly invest around 20 trillion won to be used for youth housing supply." (오기형 의원은 구체적인 재정 투입 규모로 약 20조 원을 제안했다. 오 의원은 “추가 세수라고 하는 표현의 세수가 있다”며 “과감하게 20조원 정도는 들여서 청년 주거 공급에 쓰여야 하는 게 아닌가 싶다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Cho Hee-dae, Who Destroys the Rule of Law, Must Step Down... Ordered Nationwide Banners" (김민석 “법치파괴 조희대 물러나라... 전국에 현수막 지시”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok: "Cho Hee-dae, Who Destroys the Rule of Law, Must Step Down... Ordered Nationwide Banners" (김민석 “법치파괴 조희대 물러나라... 전국에 현수막 지시”)

Kim Min-seok, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 20th, "Based on former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan's wisdom, resolve, and transparency of putting the party first, I will carry on the legacy of a 'game maker' who builds a grand framework leading to the next general election and successive governance." (김민석 더불어민주당 대표는 20일 “이해찬 전 국무총리의 지혜와 결기, 선당후사의 투명성에 기초해 다음 총선과 연속 집권에 이르는 판을 크게 짜는 ‘판 메이커’의 뒤를 잇겠다”고 했다.)

At a visit to former Prime Minister Lee's grave at Eunhasu Park in Sejong, Representative Kim said, "Former Prime Minister Lee's politics was, first, politics of putting the public good and the party before oneself, and second, politics of building the framework." He added, "His politics was not about seeking personal advancement but about creating a framework for a large camp and forces. For a long time, I've thought that philosophically I follow in the footsteps of Kim Dae-jung, and in terms of my role in the party, I follow in the footsteps of Lee Hae-chan." (김 대표는 이날 세종 은하수공원 이 전 총리 묘역을 참배한 자리에서 “이 전 총리의 정치는 첫째는 선공후사, 선당후사의 정치고 두 번째는 판을 만드는 정치였다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 김 대표는 “본인이 뭐가 되려고 하는 정치가 아니고 큰 진영과 세력의 판을 만드는 정치를 하셨다”며 “저는 철학적으로는 김대중의 뒤를 잇고, 당에서의 역할은 이해찬의 뒤를 잇겠다는 생각을 오랫동안 해왔다”고 했다.)

Kim further stated, "I've been thinking that I should inherit the lineage of a strategist, the lineage of a game maker, following Lee Hae-chan. I will build the framework for the Democratic Party's successive governance. Not merely a victory in the general election, but I will set the structure for successive governance while looking toward a golden era for the Democratic Party spanning 20 or 30 years." (김 대표는 그러면서 “이해찬의 뒤를 이을, 일종의 전략가의 계보, 판 메이커의 계보를 이어야 되겠다는 생각을 하고 있었다”며 “민주당 연속 집권의 판을 짜겠다. 단순한 총선 승리가 아니라 20년, 30년 민주당의 황금시대를 바라보면서 연속 집권의 틀을 짜겠다”고 했다.)

Kim also said, "As the first instruction after appointing Kim Nam-jun as the publicity committee chair, I ordered that two banners be mandatorily posted nationwide. One reads, 'We will open a golden era of democracy,' and the other, 'Cho Hee-dae, who destroys the rule of law, must step down.'" (김 대표는 또 “김남준 홍보위원장 임명 후 첫 지시로 전국에 현수막 2개를 필수로 게첩하라고 지시했다”며 “하나는 ‘민주의 황금시대를 열겠습니다’, 또 하나는 ‘법치 파괴 조희대는 물러나야 한다’”라고 설명했다.)

The previous day, at his first open supreme council meeting after taking office, Kim had referred to Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae as "a delinquent student begging not to be expelled" and told him to "get out immediately." (김 대표는 전날 취임 첫 공개 최고위에선 조희대 대법원장을 향해 “퇴학을 구걸하는 불량 학생”이라며 “당장 나가라”라고 말한 바 있다.)

item.title: North Korea's Kim Yo-jong Demands "Halt" to US-South Korea Drills, Raising Bar for Dialogue (北 김여정, 韓美훈련 축소에 “중단” 요구… 대화 문턱 높여)
item.description:
North Korea's Kim Yo-jong Demands "Halt" to US-South Korea Drills, Raising Bar for Dialogue (北 김여정, 韓美훈련 축소에 “중단” 요구… 대화 문턱 높여)

In response to US President Donald Trump's repeated offers of dialogue with North Korea, accompanied by his directive to downsize US-South Korea military exercises, Pyongyang has countered by demanding a halt to the drills, turning the ball back to Washington. Analysts interpret this as North Korea raising the threshold and the stakes for dialogue amid Trump's successive public overtures. Both Washington and Pyongyang are signaling the possibility of resuming talks, emphasizing that "relations between the leaders are good," yet neither side has made any mention of denuclearization. (한미군사훈련 축소를 지시한 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 잇따른 대북 대화 제의에 북한은 훈련 중단 등을 요구하며 공을 미국으로 넘겼다. 북한이 트럼프의 잇따른 공개 대화 제의에 대화 문턱과 몸값 높이기에 들어갔다는 분석이다. 미·북 양국 모두 “정상 간 관계는 좋다”는 점을 앞세워 대화 재개 가능성을 열어 둔 메시지를 발신하고 있으나 비핵화에 대한 언급은 어느 쪽도 하지 않고 있다.)

◆North Korea Raises Dialogue Threshold from Downsizing to Halting US-South Korea Drills, Demanding Withdrawal of "Hostile Policy" (◆한미 군사훈련 축소→중단, “대북 적대정책” 철회 등 대화 문턱 높인 北)

North Korea experts analyzed on the 20th that Kim Yo-jong, vice department director of the Workers' Party, in her statement on "positions on major international issues" issued through the Korean Central News Agency the previous day, mentioned that "the reduction or shortening of individual exercises does not change the fact that joint military exercises between the US and South Korea have been continuously conducted and are still ongoing," effectively setting the condition for dialogue as a halt to the US-South Korea military drills, not merely a reduction. (북한 전문가들은 20일 전날 김여정 노동당 부장이 조선중앙통신을 통해 발표한 ‘주요국 문제들에 대한 입장’에서 “개별적 훈련의 축소나 단축이 아니라 현재까지 미·한 사이의 합동 군사연습이 지속적으로 진행되어 오고 있고 지금도 진행 중에 있다”고 언급한 데 대해 한미군사훈련 축소가 아닌 중단을 대화 조건으로 제시한 것이라고 분석했다.)

()

Kim Yo-jong stated that although the Ulchi Freedom Shield (UFS) exercise, which began on the 17th, was significantly downsized following President Trump's directive, she "does not consider it worthy of evaluation and has no interest in it whatsoever." She added, "The reduction in scale or duration does not change the nature of these provocative and aggressive military exercises," and "the downsized exercise this time has been more than sufficiently substituted by previous joint drills." Kim Yo-jong went further, warning, "If the US side calculates to tout its recent measure as some sort of 'act of goodwill,' it will not get the answer it wants." (김여정은 지난 17일부터 시작한 ‘을지 자유의 방패(UFS)’ 훈련이 트럼프 대통령 지시에 따라 대폭 축소됐으나 “그에 대해 평할 가치도 없다고 보며 전혀 흥미를 느끼지 않는다”고 했다. 김여정은 “훈련의 규모나 기일이 줄어든다고 해서 도발적, 공격적 성격의 군사연습의 본질이 달라지는 것이 아니다”며 “이번에 축소되었다는 연습 과정이 이미 전에 진행된 연합 훈련들에 의해 충분히 대체되고도 남는다”고 했다. 김여정은 더 나아가 “미국 측이 이번에 취한 자기들의 조치를 그 무슨 ‘선의의 조치’로 선전해보려고 타산한다면 원하는 답이 나오지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

Hong Min, senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said, "By targeting the 'continuity' itself, not just the scale or duration of the drills, they have effectively set the demand level from 'reduction' to 'halt,'" adding, "Rather than a one-off gesture of goodwill, they are presenting substantive confidence-building measures and a fundamental change in hostile attitudes as the threshold for dialogue." Yang Moo-jin, chair professor at the University of North Korean Studies, also said, "It's an assertion that downsizing the US-South Korea joint exercises is not enough; the US must abolish its hostile policy," and noted, "Given that she dismissed suspicions of additional Russian troop deployments and referenced Japan's recent military moves and our pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines, this is an attempt to raise the threshold for US-North Korea dialogue by voicing objections on all security issues relevant to them." (홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “훈련의 규모나 기간이 아닌 ‘지속성’ 자체를 문제 삼아 요구 수준을 (훈련) 축소에서 사실상 ‘중단’으로 설정한 것”이라며 “일회성 선의가 아니라 실질적 신뢰구축 조치, 적대성에 대한 근본적 태도 변화를 대화의 문턱으로 제시한 것”이라고 했다. 양무진 북한대학원대학교 석좌교수도 “한미연합훈련 축소 갖고는 안 되고 미국의 적대 정책을 철폐하라는 주장”이라며 “러시아 추가 파병 의혹을 일축하고 최근 일본의 군사 동향과 우리의 핵잠 개발 추진 등을 언급한 점으로 미뤄 자신들과 유관한 모든 안보 이슈에 대한 항변을 통해 북미 대화의 문턱을 높이려는 것”이라고 했다.)

◆Late-Night Statement Issued on Day of Wang Yi's Visit to South Korea… "Making Clear There's No Compromise on Military Buildup Despite Good Relations with Trump" (◆왕이 방한일에 심야 입장 발표… “트럼프와 관계 좋지만 군사력 강화 타협 없다는 점 분명히”)

Kim Yo-jong's late-night statement came on the same day that China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi visited South Korea for the South Korea-China foreign ministerial meeting. Professor Yang Moo-jin said, "Timing it to coincide with the South Korea-China foreign ministerial meeting implies an intention to showcase leadership on Korean Peninsula issues," adding, "The emergency statement also appears aimed at curbing premature expectations for US-North Korea dialogue." (김여정의 한밤중 입장 발표는 중국의 왕이 외교부장 방한으로 한·중 외교 장관 회담이 열린 날 이뤄졌다. 양무진 교수는 “시점상 한·중 외교 장관 회담에 맞춤으로서 한반도 문제의 주도권 과시를 내포하고 있는 것”이라며 “긴급 입장 발표를 통해 북미 대화에 섣부른 기대감을 차단하는 의도도 있어 보인다”고 했다.)

Kim Yo-jong chose the format of a "statement on positions on major international issues" rather than a "message targeting the US" alone. In the order of the statement, she reaffirmed existing positions on the Russia-Ukraine war situation, the Korean Peninsula situation, and the Middle East, Europe, and Asia-Pacific situations, then highlighted the alliance with Russia as "infinitely responsible," criticized Japan's rearmament threats, and only then addressed Trump's downsizing of military exercises. Kim Yo-jong said, "We have already stated several times that our state leader (Kim Jong-un) has good personal memories and feelings toward Trump," and "the relationship between the two leaders is excellent." Nevertheless, she said, "Despite that, the US hostile policy toward North Korea has not changed, and the US and its followers are intensively conducting hostile military activities against North Korea at this very moment." Kim Yo-jong added, "We remind that regardless of the excellent relationship between the leaders of the two countries, the sovereign exercises we take to counter forces threatening our national security are very commonsensical, accurate, and necessary." This signals a continuation of the existing nuclear force-building line. Im Eul-chul, professor at Kyungnam University's Institute for Far Eastern Studies, said, "While acknowledging the 'excellent personal relationship' between Kim Jong-un and Trump, she made clear the position toward the US that there will never be a compromise on national security or military buildup due to personal ties." (김여정은 미국을 단독 상대로 설정한 ‘대미 담화’가 아닌 ‘주요국 문제들에 대한 입장 발표’ 형식을 선택했다. 발표 순서를 보면 러시아·우크라이나 전쟁 국면과 한반도 정세, 중동·유럽 및 아시아·태평양 정세에 대한 기존 입장을 재확인한 뒤 러시아와의 동맹 관계에 대해 “무한히 책임적”이라며 부각하고 일본의 재군사 위협을 비난한 뒤에야 트럼프의 군사훈련 축소에 대한 입장을 언급했다. 김여정은 “우리 국가수반(김정은)이 트럼프에 대하여 개인적으로 좋은 추억과 감정을 가지고 있다는데 대해서는 이미 여러 차례 밝힌 바 있다”며 “두 지도자의 관계는 의견 훌륭하다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “그럼에도 불구하고 미국의 대조선 적대시 정책은 변하지 않아 왔고 미국과 그 추종 무리들은 오늘 현재 이 순간도 적대적인 대조선(북한) 군사 활동을 맹렬히 벌리고 있다”고 했다. 김여정은 “조미(북미) 두 나라 지도자들 사이의 훌륭한 관계와는 무관하게 우리가 자국의 안전을 위협하는 세력들을 견제하기 위한 취해 나가는 주권적 행사들은 매우 상식적이고 적중하며 필수적인 것으로 된다는 것을 상기시킨다”고 했다. 기존의 핵 무력 강화 노선을 그대로 유지하겠다는 얘기다. 임을출 경남대 극동문제연구소 교수는 “김정은과 트럼프 간 ‘훌륭한 개인적 관계’는 인정하지만 개인적 친분 때문에 국가 안보 및 군사력 강화를 타협하는 일은 절대 없다는 명확한 대미 입장을 밝힌 것”이라고 했다.)

◆South Korean Government: "We Hope North Korea Joins in President Trump's Bold Decision" (◆정부 “트럼프 대통령의 통 큰 결단에 북측도 동참하기를”)

In response to Kim Yo-jong's statement from the previous day, the Ministry of Unification said on that day, "What must come first is ending the war on the Korean Peninsula and building a peace regime where there is no need for the two sides to fight each other." (통일부는 이날 김여정의 전날 입장 발표에 대해 “무엇보다 우선돼야 할 것은 한반도에서 전쟁을 끝내고 서로 싸울 필요가 없는 평화 체제를 만드는 것”이라는 입장을 냈다.)

The ministry stated, "President Trump's downsizing of the US-South Korea joint exercises is a decision to begin dialogue for building a peace regime on the Korean Peninsula," adding, "We hope North Korea will join in this opportunity so that President Trump's bold decision can lead to a history of peace, including the resumption of US-North Korea summit talks within this year and the establishment of a stable peace regime on the Korean Peninsula." The ministry also said, "The government will make every effort as a pacesetter and a party to peace on the Korean Peninsula so that the opportunity for peace created by President Trump as a peacemaker can yield tangible results." (통일부는 “트럼프 대통령의 한미연합연습 축소는 한반도에서 평화 체제 구축을 위한 대화를 시작하려는 결단”이라며 “트럼프 대통령의 통 큰 결단이 금년 내 미·북 정상 간 대화 재개와 한반도의 안정적 평화 체제 구축이라는 평화의 역사로 이어질 수 있도록, 북측도 이 기회에 동참하기를 기대한다”고 했다. 통일부는 “정부는 트럼프 대통령이 피스메이커로서 만든 평화의 기회가 실질적인 성과로 이어질 수 있도록 페이스메이커이자 한반도 평화의 당사자로서 모든 노력을 다할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Ahn Gyu-baek: "North Korea Has 80–120 Nuclear Weapons... We Should Not Accept U.S. Tactical Nukes" (안규백 “北 핵무기 80~120개... 美전술핵 받아들이면 안된다”)
item.description:
Ahn Gyu-baek: "North Korea Has 80–120 Nuclear Weapons... We Should Not Accept U.S. Tactical Nukes" (안규백 “北 핵무기 80~120개... 美전술핵 받아들이면 안된다”)

Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-baek said on the 20th regarding the status of North Korea's nuclear weapons: "We generally estimate around 80 to 120, but giving an exact figure is quite limited." (안규백 국방부 장관은 20일 북한의 핵무기 보유 현황에 대해 “우리가 보통은 80∼120개 정도로 보는데 정확한 수치를 말하는 것은 상당히 제한적”이라고 했다.)

Minister Ahn made these remarks while attending the National Assembly's National Defense Committee, responding to a question from People Power Party lawmaker Seong Il-jong asking for the government's assessment of North Korea's nuclear development status. (안 장관은 이날 국회 국방위원회에 출석해 북한의 핵 개발 현황에 대한 정부 평가를 묻는 국민의힘 성일종 의원 질의에 이렇게 답했다.)

Regarding U.S. President Donald Trump specifying North Korea's nuclear weapons as "57," Minister Ahn said, "The numbers seem to differ somewhat." The Ministry of National Defense stated, "The number of North Korean nuclear weapons Minister Ahn mentioned that day refers to an estimate by a domestic research institute." (안 장관은 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 북한 핵무기를 ‘57개’로 특정한 것과 관련해 “약간 숫자는 상이한 것 같다”고 했다. 국방부는 “안 장관이 이날 언급한 북한 핵무기 수량은 국내 연구기관이 추정한 수량을 언급한 것”이라고 했다.)

President Trump, in a meeting with reporters at the White House, said he was "getting along very well" with North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un, adding, "He has 57 very powerful nuclear weapons." It is highly unusual for a U.S. president to specifically cite a figure related to North Korea's nuclear arsenal. Details on North Korea's nuclear capabilities are classified information between South Korea and the United States. (트럼프 대통령은 백악관에서 취재진과 만난 자리에서 김정은 북한 국무위원장과 “잘 지내고 있다”며 “그는 57개의 매우 강력한 핵무기를 갖고 있다”고 했다. 미국 대통령이 북한의 핵무기 관련 수치를 구체적으로 특정한 건 상당히 이례적인 일이다. 북한 핵 능력과 관련한 세부 내용은 한미 양국의 기밀 사안이다.)

When asked whether he acknowledged that North Korea possesses nuclear weapons, Minister Ahn said, "That cannot be officially acknowledged." To a question asking whether President Trump's specific mention of 57 nuclear weapons constituted recognition of North Korea's nuclear arsenal, he said, "It seems inappropriate for the South Korean defense minister to comment on that." Minister Ahn added, "We cannot develop nuclear weapons. We also should not accept the deployment of U.S. tactical nuclear weapons, and we are consistently pursuing a policy of receiving a firm commitment to the U.S. nuclear umbrella." (안 장관은 북한이 핵을 갖고 있는 것은 인정하느냐는 질문에는 “그것은 공식적으로 인정할 수 없다”고 했다. 핵무기 숫자를 트럼프 대통령이 57개라고 구체적으로 거론한 것은 북한의 핵무기 보유를 인정한 것 아니냐는 질문에는 “한국 국방장관이 거기에 대해 논평한다는 건 적절치 않은 것 같다”고 했다. 안 장관은 “우리는 핵을 개발할 수 없다”며 “미국의 전술핵(배치)도 우리가 받아들이면 안 된다”면서 “미국의 핵우산을 확실히 제공받는 정책으로 우리가 일관되게 나가고 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

Minister Ahn also responded to Reform Party lawmaker Cheon Ha-ram, who demanded the disclosure of military service records related to allegations of desertion, saying, "I have no shame before heaven" and "It is completely contrary to the facts." He added, "If there were any such desertion, then I am the son of lawmaker Han Ki-ho," and "After I leave public office, I intend to settle this matter through legal and administrative procedures." (안 장관은 이날 탈영 의혹 관련 병적기록부 공개를 요구하는 개혁신당 천하람 의원에게 “하늘을 우러러 한 점 부끄러움이 없다”며 “완전 사실과 다른 내용”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “만약 탈영 이런 부분이 있다면 제가 한기호 의원 아들”이라며 “제가 공직을 그만둔 뒤 이런 부분에 대해 법적, 행정적 절차를 가지고 마무리할 생각”이라고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] National Assembly Passes Bill to Shorten Fast-Track Review Period... From Maximum 330 Days to 90 Days ([속보] 국회, 패스트트랙 심사 단축법안 가결…최장 330일→90일)
item.description:
On the 20th, the Democratic Party of Korea pushed through a revision to the National Assembly Act in a plenary session, led by the pro-ruling bloc, that shortens the review period for fast-track items from a maximum of 330 days to around 90 days. The 'Yongsan Park Creation Special Act' amendment and real estate-related bills, such as the Urban Maintenance Act and the Urban Redevelopment Act, which were originally scheduled to be handled that day, were not put on the agenda as they decided to wait and see further consultations between the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Seoul Metropolitan Government. (더불어민주당은 20일 국회 본회의에서 신속처리안건(패스트트랙) 심사 기간을 최장 330일에서 90일 수준으로 단축하는 국회법 개정안을 범여권 주도로 통과시켰다. 당초 이날 처리될 예정이었던 ‘용산공원 조성 특별법’ 개정안과 도시정비법·도시재정비법 등 부동산 관련 법안은 국토교통부와 서울시 간 협의를 더 지켜보기로 하면서 상정되지 않았다.)

At the plenary session that day, the National Assembly passed the revision to the National Assembly Act, which shortens the standing committee review period for bills designated as fast-track items from the current maximum of 180 days to 60 days, and the Legislation and Judiciary Committee review period from 90 days to 30 days. It also eliminated the current provision requiring a wait of up to 60 days after a bill is referred to the plenary session, and instead mandated that it be placed on the agenda of the first plenary session held after referral. As a result, the maximum period from fast-track designation to bill passage will be reduced from the current 330 days to around 90 days. (국회는 이날 본회의에서 패스트트랙으로 지정된 법안의 상임위원회 심사 기간을 현행 최장 180일에서 60일로, 법제사법위원회 심사 기간을 90일에서 30일로 단축하는 내용의 국회법 개정안을 가결했다. 본회의에 부의된 뒤에도 최장 60일을 기다리도록 한 현행 규정을 없애고 부의 후 처음 열리는 본회의에 상정하도록 했다. 이에 따라 패스트트랙 지정 이후 법안 처리까지 걸릴 수 있는 기간은 현행 최장 330일에서 90일 수준으로 줄어든다.)

The Democratic Party had pushed for the revision, arguing that the fast-track system, despite its name, had been operating as a 'slow track' that takes up to nearly a year to process bills. In contrast, the People Power Party opposed it, saying the ruling party could exploit the fast-track to unilaterally push through contentious legislation. When the bill was brought to the plenary session on the 31st of last month, the People Power Party launched a filibuster, but the debate automatically ended as the July extraordinary session concluded. As a result, the bill was re-submitted to the first plenary session of the August extraordinary session that day and passed by vote. (민주당은 패스트트랙이 이름과 달리 법안 처리에 최대 1년 가까이 걸리는 ‘슬로트랙’으로 운영돼 왔다며 개정을 추진해왔다. 반면 국민의힘은 거대 여당이 쟁점 법안을 단독으로 밀어붙이는 데 패스트트랙을 악용할 수 있다며 반대했다. 국민의힘은 지난달 31일 이 법안이 본회의에 상정되자 필리버스터(무제한 토론)에 나섰지만, 7월 임시국회 회기가 끝나면서 토론이 자동 종료됐다. 이에 따라 법안은 이날 8월 임시국회 첫 본회의에 다시 상정돼 표결 처리됐다.)

The National Assembly also approved the recommendation of three candidates for the Special Inspector General that day. The candidates are attorneys Choi Gil-soo (60, Judicial Research and Training Institute Class 23), Kang Ji-sik (60, Class 27), and Choi Yong-hoon (54, Class 27). They were recommended by the Democratic Party, the People Power Party, and the Korean Bar Association, respectively. President Lee Jae-myung must nominate one of them as the Special Inspector General candidate within three days of receiving the recommendation from the National Assembly. The president then appoints the inspector after a confirmation hearing at the National Assembly. (국회는 이날 특별감찰관 후보자 3명에 대한 추천안도 의결했다. 후보자는 최길수(60·사법연수원 23기) 변호사와 강지식(60·27기) 변호사, 최용훈(54·27기) 변호사다. 각각 민주당과 국민의힘, 대한변호사협회가 추천했다. 이재명 대통령은 국회로부터 후보자 추천서를 받은 날부터 3일 이내에 이들 중 1명을 특별감찰관 후보자로 지명해야 한다. 이후 국회 인사청문회를 거쳐 대통령이 임명한다.)

The Special Inspector General is a position that inspects misconduct by the president's spouse, relatives within the fourth degree of kinship, and senior public officials at or above the level of senior presidential secretary. After Lee Seok-su, the first Special Inspector General, resigned in September 2016, no successor was appointed during the Moon Jae-in and Yoon Suk Yeol administrations, leaving the position vacant for about ten years. Once this process is completed, a Special Inspector General will be appointed for the first time in a decade. The Democratic Party is pushing to hold a confirmation hearing in early September. (특별감찰관은 대통령 배우자와 4촌 이내 친족, 대통령비서실 수석비서관 이상 고위 공직자 등의 비위를 감찰하는 자리다. 2016년 9월 이석수 초대 특별감찰관이 사임한 뒤 문재인·윤석열 정부에서 후임이 임명되지 않아 약 10년간 공석이었다. 이번 절차가 마무리되면 10년 만에 특별감찰관이 다시 임명된다. 민주당은 9월 초 인사청문회를 여는 방안을 추진하고 있다.)

On the other hand, the Yongsan Park Creation Special Act amendment, which was expected to be handled that day, did not make it to the plenary session. Cheon Jun-ho, the Democratic Party's senior deputy chief whip for parliamentary affairs, and Kim Seung-su, the People Power Party's senior deputy chief whip for parliamentary affairs, held a meeting that day and agreed to postpone handling of the Yongsan Park Special Act, the Urban Maintenance Act, and the Urban Redevelopment Act by one week. Cheon said, "We decided to observe discussions between the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the Seoul mayor, reflect that, and handle it next week." (반면 이날 처리될 것으로 예상됐던 용산공원 조성 특별법 개정안은 본회의에 오르지 못했다. 천준호 민주당 원내운영수석부대표와 김승수 국민의힘 원내운영수석부대표는 이날 회동을 갖고 용산공원 특별법과 도시정비법, 도시재정비법의 처리를 일주일 미루기로 합의했다. 천 수석은 “국토부 장관과 서울시장이 논의하는 것을 지켜보고 반영해서 다음 주 처리하기로 했다”고 했다.)

The Yongsan Park Special Act amendment currently pending at the plenary session allows for the establishment of a separate development plan for sites that have already been returned, without waiting for the full return of the U.S. military base, and relaxes the standards for securing parks and green spaces in 'complex facility development districts' such as Camp Kim. It provides the institutional basis for the government to expand housing supply at Camp Kim beyond the existing plan. The amendment does not include provisions to directly permit housing supply on parts of the main Yongsan Park area, which the government and ruling party have been separately reviewing recently. (현재 본회의에 계류된 용산공원 특별법 개정안은 미군기지 전체 반환을 기다리지 않고 반환이 완료된 부지부터 별도의 조성계획을 세울 수 있도록 하고, 캠프킴 등 ‘복합시설조성지구’의 공원·녹지 확보 기준을 완화하는 내용이다. 정부가 캠프킴 주택 공급을 기존 계획보다 늘리는 데 필요한 제도적 근거가 된다. 최근 정부·여당이 별도로 검토하고 있는 용산공원 본체 일부의 주택 공급을 직접 허용하는 내용은 이번 개정안에 포함돼 있지 않다.)

However, handling of the amendment hit a snag amid the recent controversy over housing supply in Yongsan Park. Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok and Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon met privately in Jung-gu, Seoul, that day to discuss plans for utilizing Yongsan Park but failed to narrow their differences. Minister Kim advocated publicizing a plan to supply housing to young people, newlyweds, and multi-child families by utilizing some areas within Yongsan Park that are already damaged or have buildings on them, while Mayor Oh opposes converting the main Yongsan Park area for residential purposes. The two agreed to discuss the matter again next week. (다만 개정안 처리는 최근 불거진 용산공원 주택 공급 논란과 맞물려 제동이 걸렸다. 김윤덕 국토부 장관과 오세훈 서울시장은 이날 서울 중구에서 비공개로 만나 용산공원 활용 방안을 논의했지만 입장 차를 좁히지 못했다. 김 장관은 용산공원 내 이미 훼손되거나 건물이 들어선 일부 부지를 활용해 청년·신혼부부·다자녀 가구 등에 주택을 공급하는 방안을 공론화하자는 입장인 반면, 오 시장은 용산공원 본체를 주거 용도로 전환하는 데 반대하고 있다. 두 사람은 다음 주 다시 논의하기로 했다.)

In addition, the National Assembly handled about 70 agenda items that day, including a bill to expand the scope of those eligible to claim damages related to May 18 democratic merit figures, and a revision to the National Basic Living Security Act allowing matters related to basic livelihood security benefits to be notified via electronic documents. <<>> (이 밖에도 국회는 이날 5·18 민주유공자 관련 손해배상 청구 대상 범위를 넓히는 법안과 기초생활보장급여 관련 사항을 전자문서로 통지할 수 있도록 하는 국민기초생활보장법 개정안 등 70여 건의 안건을 처리했다.)

item.title: China's Foreign Ministry Calls South and North Korea 'Two Countries'... Concerns Raised Over Acceptance of North Korea's 'Two States' Theory (中 외교부 ‘한국·조선 두 나라’… “北의 두 국가론 수용 우려”)
item.description:
Concerns are being raised that China's Foreign Ministry, in its press release on the South Korea-China foreign ministers' meeting, referred to the two Koreas as "the two countries of South Korea and North Korea (Joseon)," suggesting possible acceptance of North Korea's hostile 'two states' theory. (중국 외교부가 한·중 외교장관 회담 보도자료에서 남북을 “한국과 조선(북한) 두 나라”로 지칭한 것을 놓고 북한의 적대적 두 국가론을 수용한 것 아니냐는 우려가 나온다.)

In a press release posted on its website after 11 p.m. on the 19th (local time), China's Foreign Ministry introduced the remarks made by both Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul and Foreign Minister Wang Yi at their meeting held in Seoul, stating that Minister Wang said he "hopes that the two countries of South Korea and North Korea can gradually move toward peace or coexistence, and sincerely wishes for the sustained stability and development of the Korean Peninsula." (중국 외교부는 19일 밤 11시(현지 시각) 이후 홈페이지에 게재한 회담 보도자료에서 서울에서 열린 조현 외교부 장관과 왕이 외교부장의 외교장관 회담 모두 발언을 소개하면서 왕 부장이 “한국과 조선(북한) 두 나라가 점차 평화 또는 공존의 기회를 따라나갈 수 있기를 바라며, 또 한반도의 지속적인 안정과 발전을 이루기를 진심으로 축원한다”고 했다고 밝혔다.)

◆ China's Foreign Ministry Wording 'Two Countries: South Korea and North Korea'... Suggests Acceptance of North Korea's Hostile Two States Theory (◆中 외교부 “한국·조선 두 나라” 표기…”北 적대적 두 국가론 수용 시사”)

China's Foreign Ministry stated that "Minister Wang, in response to a question, introduced his views on the situation on the Korean Peninsula" and "explained China's consistent principled position." According to the Chinese Foreign Ministry, Minister Wang said, "As a responsible major power, China's foreign policy maintains continuity and stability, and China is committed to playing a constructive role for peace and stability on the peninsula," adding that he is "optimistic that the two countries of South Korea and North Korea will gradually move toward peaceful coexistence and ultimately realize long-term, sustained stability on the peninsula." South Korea's Foreign Ministry, in its own press release on the meeting, phrased Minister Wang's remarks as referring to the "two sides of the South and the North." China excluded from its statement the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula that was included in Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul's remarks. (중국 외교부는 “왕 부장은 질문을 받고 조선반도(한반도) 정세에 관한 견해를 소개했다”며 “중국의 일관된 원칙적 입장을 설명했다”고 했다. 중국 외교부에 따르면 왕 부장은 “중국은 책임 있는 대국(강대국)으로서 그 외교 정책은 연속성과 안정성을 유지하고 있고, 반도(한반도)의 평화·안정을 위해 건설적 역할을 수행하는 데 힘쓰고 있다”면서 “한국과 조선 두 나라가 점차 평화 공존을 향해 나아가고 최종적으로 반도의 장기적이고 지속적인 안정을 실현할 것이라고 낙관한다”고 했다. 우리 외교부는 회담 보도자료에서 왕 부장 발언을 “남북”으로 표현했다. 중국은 조현 외교부 장관 발언에 포함된 한반도 비핵화는 발표문에서 제외했다.)

Joo Jae-woo, a professor of Chinese Studies at Kyung Hee University, wrote on Facebook on the 20th that Minister Wang "signaled an intention to accept North Korea's hostile two states theory" and noted that "since North Korea formalized (the hostile two states theory) in 2024, China had remained silent." Professor Joo said, "As far as I can recall, this is the first time China has used the expression 'two countries, South and North Korea,'" and regarding Minister Wang's remark about "gradually moving toward peaceful coexistence," he added that it "implies agreement with the endpoint of the hostile two states theory." (주재우 경희대 중국학과 교수는 20일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 왕 부장이 “북한의 적대적 두 국가론을 수용하는 의사를 시사했다”며 “2024년 북한이 (적대적 두 국가론을) 공식화한 이후 중국은 묵묵부답의 입장이었다”고 했다. 주 교수는 “중국이 ‘남북한 두개 국가’라는 표현을 쓴 것은 제 기억상 처음”이라며 왕 부장이 “점차 평화 공존을 향해 나아가고”라고 발언한 데 대해서도 “적대적 두 국가론의 종착지에 동의를 암시하는 대목”이라고 했다.)

Article 5 of the 1992 South Korea-China Joint Communiqué on the establishment of diplomatic relations states: "The Chinese side supports the peaceful unification of the Korean Peninsula by the Korean people." This can be seen as reflecting a position that views the two Koreas not as separate, distinct countries but as entities moving toward 'peaceful unification.' North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un, through a party plenary meeting in December 2023 and a policy speech at the Supreme People's Assembly in January 2024, defined inter-Korean relations as a 'hostile belligerent relationship' and banned expressions such as 'unification,' 'the Korean people,' and 'three thousand ri of beautiful rivers and mountains.' (1992년 한·중 수교 공동성명 제5조는 “중국 측은 한반도가 한민족에 의해 평화적으로 통일되는 것을 지지한다”고 명시되어 있다. 남북을 각각 분리된 별개 국가가 아닌 ‘평화적 통일’을 향해 나아가는 관계로 보는 입장이 담긴 것으로 볼 수 있다. 북한의 김정은 국무위원장은 2023년 12월 당 전원회의와 2024년 1월 최고인민회의 시정연설을 통해 남북 관계를 ‘적대적 교전국 관계’로 규정하고 ‘통일’ ‘한민족’ ‘삼천리 금수강산’ 등에 대한 표현을 금지했다.)

◆ "China's 'South Korea and North Korea' Expression Should Not Be Overlooked" (◆ “中의 ‘한국과 북한’ 표현 그냥 간과해선 안 돼”)

Kim Gun, a lawmaker of the People Power Party and a former diplomat, also wrote on Facebook the same day: "Minister Wang Yi's public reference to the South and the North as 'the two countries of South Korea and North Korea' is not an expression to be taken lightly," adding, "Until now, in summit meetings or foreign ministers' meetings between South Korea and China, China has mainly used expressions such as 'both sides of the South and the North' or 'inter-Korean relations' when referring to Korean Peninsula issues." Rep. Kim noted, "It was the same even after Kim Jong-un defined inter-Korean relations as a 'hostile relationship between two states' at the end of 2023," adding, "Even during former Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul's visit to China in 2024, in his meeting with Minister Wang Yi, China referred to 'Korean Peninsula issues' but did not describe the two Koreas as 'two countries.'" (외교관 출신인 김건 국민의힘 의원도 이날 페이스북에 “왕이 부장이 공개 석상에서 남북을 ‘한국과 북한 두 나라(韩朝两个国家)’라고 칭한 것은 그냥 지나칠 표현이 아니다”며 “그동안 한중 정상회담이나 외교장관 회담에서 중국은 한반도 문제를 언급할 때 주로 ‘남북 양측’ ‘남북 관계’ 등의 표현을 사용해 왔다”고 했다. 김 의원은 “2023년 말 김정은이 남북 관계를 ‘적대적인 두 국가 관계’로 규정한 이후에도 마찬가지였다”며 “2024년 조태열 당시 외교부 장관의 방중 당시 왕이 부장과의 회담에서도 중국은 ‘한반도 문제’를 언급했지만 남북을 ‘두 나라’라고 표현하지 않았다”고 했다.)

Rep. Kim said, "This episode is a preview of what could happen the moment we start calling North Korea 'Joseon,'" adding, "The South and the North will come to be seen as two separate nations, and our claim to jurisdiction over North Korea will weaken." He further stated, "If the perception of the two Koreas as completely separate countries becomes entrenched in the international community, it would undermine not only the principle of peaceful unification stipulated in the Republic of Korea's Constitution but also the constitutional and historical ties and standing the Republic of Korea holds in its relationship with North Korea." Rep. Kim added, "It has been revealed that these issues are being brought to the surface rashly, without sufficient internal coordination within the government or national consensus, sending the wrong signals to neighboring countries," and warned, "The government must keep in mind that it may pay a heavy price by giving neighboring countries justification to engage on inter-Korean relations and Korean Peninsula issues in directions contrary to the will of the Republic of Korea." (김 의원은 “이번 에피소드는 우리가 북한을 ‘조선’이라 부르는 순간 어떠한 일이 일어날지의 예고편”이라며 “남북은 남남처럼 여겨지게 되고, 북한에 대한 우리의 연고권은 약화되어 갈 것”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “그러다 남북을 완전히 별개의 두 국가로 보는 인식이 국제사회에서 굳어지기 시작한다면 대한민국 헌법이 명시한 평화 통일의 원칙은 물론, 북한과의 관계에서 대한민국이 갖는 헌법적·역사적 연계성과 당사자성을 훼손하게 될 것”이라고 했다. 김 의원은 “정부 내부의 충분한 조율도, 국민적 공감대도 없는 상황에서 이런 문제를 섣불리 표면화하다가 주변국에 잘못된 신호를 주고 있다는 것이 밝혀졌다”며 “주변국들이 남북 관계와 한반도 문제에 대해 대한민국의 뜻과 다른 방향으로 관여할 명분을 스스로 만들어주는 값비싼 대가를 치를 수도 있다는 점을 정부는 명심해야 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Unification Minister Chung Dong-young has repeatedly advocated for 'peaceful two-state relations' in inter-Korean relations and has often referred to North Korea by its official name, the 'Democratic People's Republic of Korea,' or its abbreviated form, 'Joseon.' Subsequently, President Lee Jae-myung, during a Unification Ministry work plan briefing held at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House on the 5th, cautioned Minister Chung, saying, "Using the official names of the two Koreas is a matter open to debate," and advised a cautious approach. (정동영 통일부 장관은 그간 남북 관계의 ‘평화적 두 국가 관계’를 주장하며 북한을 종종 정식 국호인 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국’ 또는 이를 축약한 ‘조선’으로 호칭했다. 이후 이재명 대통령은 지난 5일 청와대 영빈관에서 열린 통일부 업무 계획 보고에서 정 장관을 향해 “남북한 공식 명칭을 부르는 일은 논쟁의 여지가 있는 일”이라며 신중한 접근을 당부했었다.)

◆ North Korea and China Speaking with One Voice Following Summit (◆정상회담 이후 한목소리 내는 北·中 )

Since Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to North Korea in June, the two countries have agreed on strategic support regarding the situation on the Korean Peninsula and core national security interests, and have been speaking with one voice on foreign policy issues, including relations with the United States. The previous day, Minister Wang, regarding the possibility of mediating U.S.-North Korea summit talks, drew a line saying, "It is a matter for North Korea and the United States to decide," while adding, "In particular, the United States must change its long-standing hostile policy toward North Korea." Around the same time, Kim Yo-jong, a department director of the North Korean Workers' Party, in her "Position on Issues of Major Countries" released through the Korean Central News Agency, stated that "the U.S. hostile policy toward North Korea has not changed" and demanded that the United States withdraw its hostile policy toward the North. (북·중 양국은 시진핑 중국 국가 주석의 지난 6월 방북을 계기로 한반도 정세 및 국가 안보 핵심 이익에 대한 전략적 지지를 합의한 뒤 대미 관계 등 대외 정책에서 같은 목소리를 내고 있다. 전날 왕 부장은 미·북 정상회담 중재 가능성에 대해 “북한과 미국 사이에 결정할 일”이라며 선을 긋고 “특히 미국은 오랫동안 유지해 온 대북 적대 정책을 바꿔야 한다”고 했다. 비슷한 시간 북한의 김여정 노동당 부장도 조선중앙통신을 통해 내놓은 ‘주요국 문제들에 대한 입장’에서 “미국의 대조선 적대시 정책은 변하지 않아 왔고”라며 미국의 대북 적대시 정책 철회를 요구했다.)

Meanwhile, Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul, in a post on Facebook on the 20th, wrote, "Following yesterday's meeting and dinner, this morning I had a friendly schedule with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in a more relaxed atmosphere," and posted a photo of the two walking side by side along the Namsan fortress wall. Minister Cho said, "Next year marks the 35th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between South Korea and China," adding, "I will work actively with Minister Wang to continue the momentum of development in bilateral relations that has been revived through the mutual state visits of our two heads of state." (한편 조현 외교부 장관은 20일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “어제 회담 및 만찬에 이어 오늘 아침에는 보다 편안한 분위기에서 중국 왕이 외교부장과 친교 일정을 가졌다”며 나란히 남산 성곽길을 걷는 사진을 올렸다. 조 장관은 “내년이면 한중 수교 35주년을 맞는다”며 “양국 정상의 상호 국빈 방문을 계기로 되살아난 양국 관계 발전의 흐름을 이어가도록 왕 부장과 함께 적극 노력해 나가겠다”고 했다.)
